title: Nova live-continuation manifest v2 (written by nova-chain)
description: Structural schema only; nova-chain's load_generation is the authority. Before decoding the payload it checks schema, backend, network, k, completed_steps*k = end_height - initial_height, the circuit identity and public-parameter digest of a fresh setup, canonical decoding and digests of both states, state heights, and the anchor policy (genesis-anchored chains must start at the consensus genesis state). It then checks the payload size cap and SHA-256, decodes the RecursiveSNARK, requires its step count to equal completed_steps, verifies it against initial_state, and requires its output to equal end_state. v2 differs from the v1 proposal: any network; initial_height may be 0 (genesis); public_params_digest is Nova's own digest of the parameters; the verifier key is pinned per (network, k) as expected_verifier_key_sha256 and checked at export; input_chain_sha256 chains SHA-256 over each step's headers; generation and end are added.

circuit_identity_sha256.description: SHA-256 of network, k and the primary/secondary constraint and variable counts.
